lobby: Four: six stockings and three voices in one pair of headphones. Two: 15 to 25 minutes.

plan.idea: A deduction: the right order of five presents is hidden. Hang a guess and the mantel's lamps show how many stockings are right, not which.

now.tag: A deduction: which present goes in which stocking?

chain.at: the cottage parlour, an ordinary open room
chain.has: eight presents, five stockings, and five lamps that count how many are right

now.win: All five stockings hold their right present.
now.cost: Nothing: swap presents and read the lamps again. No clock.
now.own: The lamps say how many are right, never which.
now.lobby: One can work it out alone; more share the carrying and the arguing.

name: Summit Shot
tag: The Lob House: a blind lob over a wall, on the summit

chain.has: lamp panel beside the baskets' shapes; the lamps change places

chain.via: intercom, heard only on the deck

chain.has: sees the baskets and every landing
snowballs; a 3.3 m wall in front

win: 8 baskets in a row before the clock runs out (10 with four players).
cost: A ball in the wrong basket empties the streak. Misses are free: the balls roll back to the thrower.
own: A blind lob into a 0.84 m basket. Missing costs nothing, which no other streak puzzle allows.
lobby: Four: a second caller with half the lamps. Two: the lamps move to the spotter's deck.

plan.idea: For two: the thrower cannot see the baskets over the wall, the spotter on the deck can, and they simply talk. No blindfold, no hut, no clock. Four baskets, each once; a miss costs nothing.

now.tag: For two: lob snowballs over a wall while a spotter calls where they land

chain.at: the deck outside the gallery's glass
chain.has: sees the four baskets and every landing

chain.at: a timber pen behind a 3.3 m wall
chain.has: twelve snowballs; cannot see the baskets

now.win: Each of the four baskets once, in any order.
now.cost: Nothing: missed balls are laid back in the tray. No clock.
now.own: Throwing blind, by another player's corrections.
now.lobby: More players take turns throwing.

name: Thin Ice
tag: A blind crossing of a frozen pond with open water in it

chain.has: lamp map of the pond
sees the pond; hears only the spotter
25 floes in a grid, five of them open water

win: 10 floes in a row, 17 s each: stand on the lit floe with nobody on any other (8 with four players).
cost: Any miss, or a fall into a hole, resets the count to zero.
own: Holes on the route: the straight line is often the wrong one, and the walker cannot see it.
lobby: Four: two spotters with half a map each. Two: one link fewer, 15 s.

plan.idea: For two: the map hangs on the watch tower. One reads it and talks the blindfolded crosser to the lit floe, round the holes. Six floes, no phase timer.

now.tag: For two: a guide on the tower and a blindfolded crosser

chain.has: a lamp map of the floes on the wall behind them; sees the pond
25 floes in a grid, five of them open water

now.win: Six lit floes reached, one at a time. Stand on the lit floe for a moment and it counts.
now.cost: Nothing: stepping on other floes is free, and a fall into a hole only costs the climb out. No clock.
now.own: The ice is for the blindfolded only: anyone on it without the blindfold is set back outside. So it takes two.
now.lobby: More players can share the guiding or take turns on the ice.

name: Whispering Chimney
tag: Tunes heard down four chimneys, matched by humming both ways

chain.has: each hears one chimney's tune; hums it
compares two hums and gives the verdict
nine speaking tiles; hums candidates back

win: 3 tunes hung in chimney order (4 with four players), then poke the validator.
cost: A wrong answer stops the puzzle and the next start deals new tunes. No clock.
own: The one line that runs both ways: candidates are hummed back and the relay judges two hums, neither of them the real tune. No clock.
lobby: Four: a fourth chimney.

plan.idea: Each chimney's tune can be heard at its own hearth. Match the tiles by ear and hang them in chimney order. No chairs and no relay.

now.tag: Tunes down four chimneys, matched by ear

chain.at: the listening chairs by the chimneys, and the tile shed 22 m away
chain.has: each chair plays one chimney's tune; nine speaking tiles and a board with a slot for each chimney

now.win: Hang the tile that plays each chimney's tune in that chimney's colour, then press check.
now.cost: A wrong check only shows the cross. No clock.
now.own: Carrying a tune in your head for 22 m, or humming it to a friend at the shed.
now.lobby: Four players: a fourth chimney.

name: Whiteout Maze
tag: A blindfolded walker talked through a maze where a wrong turn ends it

chain.has: lamp board with a picture beside each lamp
sees the pictures lying face-up over 8 cairns, and the walker
walls too tall to see over

win: 6 cairns before the clock runs out.
cost: Stepping into the wrong dead end stops the puzzle.
own: A wrong turn is fatal, not just slow. The lamp board is shuttered unless someone stands on the gantry.
lobby: Four: two blind walkers must reach each cairn together.

plan.idea: A maze of gates: standing on a coloured plate holds a gate open somewhere else, so the group leapfrogs through three gates to the star. No blindfold, no clock.

now.tag: A maze of three gates that open only while a friend stands on a plate

chain.at: a coloured plate in a dead end
chain.has: while someone stands on it, the gates of its colour stand open

chain.via: shout over the walls; anyone on the gantry sees the whole maze

chain.has: goes through, finds the next plate and holds the gate for the others

now.win: Anyone steps into the star's cell beyond the third gate.
now.cost: Nothing: step off a plate and its gates shut. Every stretch has a way out. No clock.
now.own: Leapfrogging: each later plate also holds the gate behind it, so the holder can be fetched through.
now.lobby: Two can finish it; with three or four, everyone but the last holder reaches the star.
